query: Last weekend I took my golden retriever to the new dog park near the community center, and he had so much fun chasing after a frisbee with a group of other puppies, I even ended up exchanging contact info with one of the other owners so we can set up playdates later. I also tried that new matcha boba shop on Oak Street yesterday, the taro flavor with 50% sugar and extra pearls was absolutely perfect, I'm already planning to go back again this weekend to try their honeydew smoothie. Oh right, I also need to return some items from my delivered order, I'd like to return items 9612497925, 7127170374, and 6268080249 from order #W1679211, and please process the refund to my paypal_3022415 payment method.
